{{Top|leg}}
'''Triakk''' was the ancient [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] god of chaos. At the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], she was revered as the "Merciful Warren Mother of all Sullust".
